summary: Build logframes, budgets, dashboards, and reporting skills in 5 days. Train with TrainingCred and manage public health programmes with confidence.
lede: Project management in public health connects service priorities, resources, delivery, and measurement in accountable programmes. For public health programme managers, monitoring and evaluation staff, coordinators, and planners, this course addresses the practical task of turning health needs into workable plans and tracking delivery. You will practise building a logical framework and budget, setting indicators and dashboard workflows, and coordinating stakeholders and risks to report results and guide improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work inside public health programme delivery and need stronger control over planning, monitoring, accountability, and reporting.
prerequisites: Prior experience in public health operations, programme delivery, health systems coordination, or monitoring and evaluation is recommended. You should have a working understanding of public health indicators, basic budgeting concepts, and routine reporting workflows. Familiarity with spreadsheets is helpful for programme tracking and KPI analysis, but coding is not required. If your role involves planning, supervision, reporting, or partner coordination, you will be able to apply the course directly.
